name: Mind Lab Pro
summary: The most comprehensively researched nootropic stack on the market and our #1 pick for LATAM buyers seeking full cognitive support. Sold in USD only — no local currency option. Ships from the UK by tracked airmail (5–20 working days) or DHL courier (2–7 working days) (per mindlabpro.com, checked 2026-09-29). Mexican buyers should note the Comisión Federal para la Protección contra Riesgos Sanitarios (COFEPRIS) does not pre-approve imported supplements. Import duties and customs clearance are the buyer's responsibility. Argentine buyers face currency controls that may complicate USD card payments. Mind Lab Pro's FAQ gives a partial list of territories it ships to that does not name Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile or Peru (checked 2026-10-05) — confirm your country at checkout.
whatItIs: Mind Lab Pro is an 11-ingredient nootropic stack made by Opti-Nutra, a UK-based supplement company, designed to cover memory, focus, mental energy, mood, and long-term brain health without caffeine or proprietary blends. For LATAM buyers, it is sold exclusively in USD with no local currency checkout. The product ships internationally from the UK; we have not verified a local product registration with the Comisión Federal para la Protección contra Riesgos Sanitarios (COFEPRIS) in Mexico, the Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA) in Brazil, the Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica (ANMAT) in Argentina, the Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) in Colombia, the Instituto de Salud Pública (ISP) in Chile or the Dirección General de Medicamentos, Insumos y Drogas (DIGEMID) in Peru — it enters as a personal-use imported supplement; confirm at checkout whether it ships to your country.
howItWorks: Mind Lab Pro works across six bio-pathways simultaneously. Citicoline and Phosphatidylserine support the cholinergic system and neuronal membrane integrity. Lion's Mane stimulates Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) for neuroplasticity. Bacopa Monnieri enhances synaptic communication for memory. Rhodiola Rosea and L-Tyrosine support dopamine/norepinephrine balance under stress. L-Theanine promotes alpha brain wave activity for calm focus. B-vitamins (B6, B9, B12) support homocysteine regulation and neurotransmitter synthesis.
whatToExpect: Within 30-60 minutes: mild calm focus from L-Theanine. Within 2-4 weeks: improved mental energy and reduced cognitive fatigue (Citicoline, Tyrosine). At 8-12 weeks: measurable improvements in memory recall and learning speed (Bacopa, Lion's Mane). Mind Lab Pro is a long-game supplement -- most users report subtle but sustained improvement rather than dramatic day-one effects. Best results require 3+ months of consistent daily use.

name: NooCube
summary: Strong formula anchored by Lutemax 2020 at $64.99 USD for a 30-serving bottle — prices are in USD with no local currency option. The brand does not publish a delivery estimate for this country; check the estimate at checkout. Import duties and customs clearance are the buyer's responsibility; Argentine buyers may face currency control restrictions on USD card transactions. Note: the noocube.com Trustpilot profile has no reviews yet — verify independently before purchasing.
whatItIs: NooCube is a 12-ingredient nootropic stack made by Wolfson Brands, a large supplement manufacturer. Its standout feature for screen-heavy workers is Lutemax 2020 — a patented lutein and zeaxanthin extract with mixed evidence for screen eye strain: a 6-month trial funded by Lutemax's maker found less self-rated eye strain and eye fatigue (Stringham 2017), but a 2025 trial of a different lutein/zeaxanthin product found no change in self-rated eye strain (Lopresti 2025). For LATAM buyers, NooCube is priced exclusively in USD and ships internationally as a personal-use supplement, entering these markets under personal-import allowances; we have not verified a local product registration with the Comisión Federal para la Protección contra Riesgos Sanitarios (COFEPRIS) in Mexico, the Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA) in Brazil, the Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica (ANMAT) in Argentina, the Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) in Colombia, the Instituto de Salud Pública (ISP) in Chile or the Dirección General de Medicamentos, Insumos y Drogas (DIGEMID) in Peru. Customs duties vary by country and are the buyer's responsibility.
howItWorks: Lutemax 2020 filters high-energy blue light in the retina; trial results on screen-related eye fatigue are mixed (one maker-funded trial positive, a trial of a different lutein/zeaxanthin product null on self-rated eye strain). Choline from VitaCholine (250mg) supports the cholinergic system; the current formula no longer contains Alpha-GPC or Huperzine A. L-Theanine provides calm focus. Bacopa Monnieri targets memory consolidation over weeks.
whatToExpect: Day one: mild calm focus from L-Theanine. Lutemax: its eye-strain trials ran 6 months and disagree, so do not count on a quick eye-fatigue effect. At 8 weeks: modest memory improvements (Bacopa, though underdosed). Manage expectations accordingly: Bacopa is below the 300mg clinical anchor. The noocube.com Trustpilot profile has no reviews yet -- verify the cancellation policy before purchasing.

summary: 28 active ingredients — the most comprehensive formula in this review and the premium-tier option for experienced LATAM biohackers. Priced at $139 USD/month with no local currency option. whatItIs: Qualia Mind is a 28-ingredient nootropic stack developed by Neurohacker Collective, a San Diego-based company focused on systems biology and complex supplementation. It is the most ingredient-rich formula in this review and targets experienced supplement users who want a comprehensive single-product cognitive stack. For LATAM buyers, it is sold in USD via a US storefront that does not ship direct to Latin America (Qualia's FAQ directs other countries to iHerb). Qualia Mind enters LATAM markets under personal-import allowances; we have not verified a local product registration with the Comisión Federal para la Protección contra Riesgos Sanitarios (COFEPRIS) in Mexico, the Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA) in Brazil, the Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica (ANMAT) in Argentina, the Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) in Colombia, the Instituto de Salud Pública (ISP) in Chile or the Dirección General de Medicamentos, Insumos y Drogas (DIGEMID) in Peru. The capsule count is high: 6 per serving, 20 servings per container.
howItWorks: Qualia Mind covers more cognitive pathways than any competitor: cholinergics (Alpha-GPC, Huperzine A, Citicoline), adaptogens (Rhodiola, Bacopa), neuro-nutrients (DHA, PS), amino acid precursors (Tyrosine, Taurine, Theanine), B-vitamin complex, and several novel ingredients (Uridine Monophosphate, Pyrroloquinoline Quinone). The theory is synergistic optimisation across all cognitive systems simultaneously. Neurohacker publishes a proprietary research program supporting the formula.
whatToExpect: Acute effects on day one: sustained attention, moderate energy boost from caffeine (90mg per serving). Within 2-4 weeks: improved mental endurance and working memory. At 8-12 weeks: cumulative adaptogen and memory benefits. Important: 6 capsules per serving is a significant daily pill burden. Start with the recommended 7-day loading cycle (2 days off per week) to assess tolerance.

summary: The most commercially successful US nootropic, backed by two published clinical studies — a meaningful trust signal for LATAM buyers purchasing from abroad. Priced at $79 USD/month with no local currency option. Ships from the US; check the delivery estimate at checkout. Import duties and customs clearance are the buyer's responsibility; Argentine buyers should verify their card issuer will approve USD transactions given currency controls. Onnit's 30-day money-back guarantee covers the first purchase of each product bought directly on Onnit.com.
whatItIs: Alpha Brain is Onnit's flagship nootropic, first released in 2011 and popularised through Joe Rogan's podcast. It is the best-recognised nootropic brand in the mainstream US market and one of only two supplements in this review with published clinical trial data on its specific formula. It is National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Certified for Sport. For LATAM buyers, Alpha Brain is sold exclusively in USD and ships from the US as a personal-use imported supplement. We have not verified a local product registration with the Comisión Federal para la Protección contra Riesgos Sanitarios (COFEPRIS) in Mexico, the Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA) in Brazil, the Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica (ANMAT) in Argentina, the Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) in Colombia, the Instituto de Salud Pública (ISP) in Chile or the Dirección General de Medicamentos, Insumos y Drogas (DIGEMID) in Peru. Import duties and customs clearance are the buyer's responsibility — Onnit's 30-day money-back guarantee refunds the product cost only, not shipping.
howItWorks: Alpha Brain uses three proprietary blends -- Onnit Flow Blend, Focus Blend, and Fuel Blend -- containing cholinergics (Alpha-GPC), adaptogens (Bacopa), and amino acids (Tyrosine, Theanine). The label states each blend's total and two individual amounts (Bacopa 100mg, Huperzine A 400mcg): Bacopa, Alpha-GPC (at most 140mg) and L-Tyrosine (at most 650mg) fall short of their clinical doses, and the other blend members cannot be checked individually. The two published studies (Onnit-funded, 2016 and 2021) tested the full formula and showed statistically significant improvements in verbal memory and executive function versus placebo.
whatToExpect: Day one: subtle focus improvement, particularly noticeable for users who haven't taken cholinergic supplements before. The lack of caffeine means no energy spike -- effects are gentle. At 4-6 weeks: most users report consistent mild improvements in word retrieval and task focus. Onnit's 30-day money-back guarantee covers the first purchase of each product made directly on Onnit.com.

summary: 4 personalised formula blends per month with a nootropics coaching service — the most flexible option for LATAM buyers who want to optimise their stack before committing long-term. Priced at $79 USD/month (subscription only) with no local currency option. Ships from the US; check the delivery estimate at checkout. whatItIs: Thesis is a personalised nootropic subscription that offers four formula blends -- Clarity, Motivation, Stress Reset and Neuroprotection -- along with access to a nootropics coaching service. Rather than a fixed formula, it lets you rotate blends on different days to find what works best for your cognitive profile. The ingredient rows on this page cover the four formulas whose labels Thesis publishes; the Energy, Logic, Creativity and Confidence product pages returned 404 when we checked on 8 October 2026. For LATAM buyers, Thesis operates exclusively in USD with no local currency checkout and ships from the US as a personal-use supplement subscription. None of the blends are registered with the Comisión Federal para la Protección contra Riesgos Sanitarios (COFEPRIS) in Mexico, the Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA) in Brazil, ANMAT (Argentina), the Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) in Colombia, ISP (Chile), or DIGEMID (Peru). Because Thesis is subscription-based, each monthly shipment is a separate import event, which increases cumulative exposure to customs duties and delays — particularly relevant for buyers in Brazil and Argentina.
howItWorks: Each Thesis formula targets a different goal, and Thesis lists an amount for every ingredient. Clarity: CDP choline 250mg, Panax ginseng 200mg, Lion's Mane 500mg, 7,8-dihydroxyflavone 30mg and vitamin B6 5mg. Motivation: Dynamine (methylliberine) 100mg, theacrine 100mg, N-acetyl-L-tyrosine 400mg, Rhodiola (fermented salidrosides) 60mg, vitamin B6 5mg, vitamin B12 1000mcg, L-theanine 200mg and caffeine 150mg. Stress Reset: ashwagandha 120mg, saffron 28mg, Zembrin 25mg, Rhodiola (fermented salidrosides) 30mg, magnesium bisglycinate 84mg and dihydrohonokiol-B 10mg. Neuroprotection: Bacopa 300mg, Ginkgo 120mg, mustard seed 50mg, broccoli seed 125mg, turmeric 200mg, CoQ10 100mg, PQQ 20mg, NADH 20mg, spermidine 10mg and selenium 200mcg. Clarity, Stress Reset and Neuroprotection are sold with or without caffeine (the caffeinated capsules add caffeine 100mg, plus L-theanine 100mg in Stress Reset and Neuroprotection); Motivation contains 150mg caffeine per two-capsule serving. The personalisation model allows you to match your cognitive demand of the day with the appropriate formula.
whatToExpect: First month: expect an experimentation period. You'll rotate through 4 blends, 7 days each, to assess which has the most noticeable effect for you. Clarity blend effects build over 2-4 weeks. Coaching service adds value for users who want guidance on optimising their protocol.

name: Lion's Mane Extract
summary: Gold standard for single-ingredient Lion's Mane — the best-value entry point for LATAM buyers exploring nootropics for the first time, at $25 USD/month with no local currency option. ISO in-house lab publishes a Certificate of Analysis (CoA) per batch, a useful trust signal when buying supplements from abroad. Ships from the US. The brand does not publish a delivery estimate for this country; check the estimate at checkout. Import duties and customs clearance are the buyer's responsibility, and Argentine buyers face currency controls that may complicate USD card payments.
whatItIs: Nootropics Depot Lion's Mane Extract is a single-ingredient supplement providing standardised Hericium erinaceus fruiting body extract at 500mg per capsule. Nootropics Depot is widely regarded as the most quality-focused retailer in the US nootropics market, operating an ISO-certified in-house testing lab and publishing a CoA for every batch — documentation that LATAM buyers can use to verify product identity if questioned by customs. For LATAM buyers, the product is priced exclusively in USD and ships from the US as a personal-use supplement, entering these markets under personal-import allowances; we have not verified a local product registration with the Comisión Federal para la Protección contra Riesgos Sanitarios (COFEPRIS) in Mexico, the Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA) in Brazil, the Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica (ANMAT) in Argentina, the Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) in Colombia, the Instituto de Salud Pública (ISP) in Chile or the Dirección General de Medicamentos, Insumos y Drogas (DIGEMID) in Peru. The lower per-shipment value ($25 USD) reduces the likelihood of significant customs duties compared to higher-priced stacks.
howItWorks: Lion's Mane fruiting body contains hericenones, compounds that cross the blood-brain barrier and stimulate Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) synthesis. NGF promotes neuronal survival, axon growth, and maintenance of neurons in the hippocampus and cortex -- the regions responsible for learning and memory. Nootropics Depot uses a standardised fruiting body extract rather than mycelium (which has a lower hericenone content). The result is a more potent and consistent NGF stimulus per capsule.
whatToExpect: Lion's Mane is a long-game supplement. Expect no acute effects on day one. At 4 weeks: some users report slightly clearer thinking and improved mental endurance. At 8-12 weeks: measurable improvements in memory and neuroprotective markers in studies. For best results, take consistently every day with a fat-containing meal (hericenones are fat-soluble). This product is best combined with a multi-ingredient stack (e.g. Mind Lab Pro already contains Lion's Mane) rather than used as a standalone primary supplement.
